name: Contour-Tree-Defined Segmentation
definition: A segmentation method where each arc of the contour tree represents the union of all contours mapping to it, defining a 'topological zone' as the volume swept out by the contour as its isovalue varies from creation to destruction.
summary: Contour-Tree-Defined Segmentation partitions a scalar volume into topological zones based on contour tree arcs, automating feature isolation via topological computation rather than manual sketching.
